description: This file declares structures and functions for a quasi peak filter used in audio signal processing, including initialization and processing functions.

methods.name: LVPSA_QPD_Process
methods.description: Applies downsampling, post gain, quasi peak filtering, and writes level values every 20 ms.

methods.name: LVPSA_QPD_Init
methods.description: Initializes a quasi peak filter instance with provided taps and coefficients.
